# mergeah_application_credential (Resource)

Manage an OAuth application credential. client_secret cannot be read back and is retained in sensitive Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_application_credential" "example" {
  connector_slug = "linear"
  client_id      = "your-oauth-client-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Merge API field `client_id`.
- `connector_slug` (String) Merge API field `connector_slug`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Merge API field `client_secret`.
- `external_id` (String) Merge API field `external_id`.
- `oauth2_scopes_override` (String) Space-separated OAuth scope override. Retains the configured string when Merge returns null or omits this field, including normalization to connector defaults. Remote clearing cannot then be distinguished from normalization; different non-null scopes are detected as drift.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Value reported by Merge: `created_at`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.
- `is_global_default` (Boolean) Value reported by Merge: `is_global_default`.
- `modified_at` (String) Value reported by Merge: `modified_at`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_application_credential.example '134e0111-0f67-44f6-98f0-597000290bb3'
```
